neutralAnswers.rationale: Educated assumption: Neutral / conditional is the most likely institutional interpretation of this specific proposition. The Yunus-led interim administration governed without an elected legislature throughout 2025 while preparing a return to elections. The Awami League ban and continuing coercion qualify liberalisation; temporary advisers are not evidence of a permanent expert-selection constitution. Executive ordinance-making operated without a legislature; the literal claim of overriding an existing parliamentary rejection is not equivalent. Emergency decrees within legislative constraints differ from overriding an explicit parliamentary rejection. The response reflects the identified competing institutional elements, rather than neutrality substituted for uncertainty. The sources do not document an official answer to this exact statement; the normative comparison and its stated trade-off remain uncertain.
